aboutGame.title: What is Loot to Forge?
paragraphs: Loot to Forge is a Roblox incremental dungeon crawler from Good Bro Studio. You click and train to raise your Power stat, march into a linear dungeon to defeat hordes of enemies, and carry back the ores and loot they drop. Every ore feeds the forge, and every sword you craft lets you push one floor deeper.

Progression follows a tight loop: gather loot, forge stronger gear, then clear the floors that were out of reach a run ago. Upgrades raise your bag capacity and combat stats, enchantments and weapon skills sharpen your build, and Rebirth trades your Power stat for permanent Power gain and Coin multipliers once you reach the required threshold.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Loot to Forge.

items.question: What is Loot to Forge?
items.answer: Loot to Forge is a Roblox incremental dungeon crawler from Good Bro Studio. You click and train to build up your Power stat, fight through a linear dungeon, collect the ores and loot that enemies drop, and forge stronger swords so you can clear even deeper floors.

items.question: How do I gain Power fast in Loot to Forge?
items.answer: Two systems feed your Power stat in Loot to Forge: manual sword slashes with the left mouse button, and the auto-training area that keeps generating Power while you do something else. Leave auto-training running whenever you are banking loot or sorting inventory, and save manual clicking for pushing past a dungeon wall.

items.question: Does Loot to Forge have working codes?
items.answer: Not yet. Loot to Forge has no code redemption box, so no codes are live right now. Free rewards still exist: a daily login bonus, playtime gift chests that scale with session length, and one free Tower Ticket each day. This wiki tracks codes the moment Good Bro Studio adds them.

items.question: When should I Rebirth in Loot to Forge?
items.answer: Rebirth in Loot to Forge the moment the option unlocks. A Rebirth resets your Power stat to zero but grants permanent Power gain and Coin earning multipliers plus better training dummies, so delaying only wastes Power you have already trained past the threshold.

items.question: How deep should I push in the Loot to Forge dungeon?
items.answer: Push until enemies stop dying in four hits or fewer. That is the signal in Loot to Forge that the next floor outpaces your sword, so retreat, bank your ore, and spend the haul on training or a better forge before you risk dying and losing a full bag.
